title: Bug: test_route_withdraw_advertise does not properly clean up on test failure due to assertion
author: peterbailey-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When running TestRouteConsistency::test_route_withdraw_advertise individually, if it fails from a pytest_assert on the first attempt then subsequent attempts will also fail as it leaves the dut in a poor state.

Reloading/rebooting the dut can recover.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run TestRouteConsistency::test_route_withdraw_advertise, if it fails at `pytest_assert wait_until routes_have_changed` then it does not properly clean up for subsequent testing.

Bug can be replicated by putting `pytest_assert(False, "dummy assertion")` here instead.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expect test to clean up properly.

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix TestRouteConsistency to re-announce on pytest assert failure
linkedPullRequests.author: peterbailey-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
When `pytest assert routes_have_changed` fails, the test then fails within the `try` but the pytest failure is not caught by the Exception class.

We need to also catch the pytest failure exception for routes to be re-announced.

Same applies for cleanup in the other tests in TestRouteConsistency
